title: q_max decision D-757 (wt-main is the one database testers share) is rewritten to the ruling that stands now
why: Coordinator 13:07 CST Nov 8, found by lane qmax-worktree-db-after-neon-purge (session_013NEJL1kqjrZZqdqpz3eaGB), #1138: D-757 names Neon branch wt-main, which the 2026-11-08 purge deleted (113 wt- branches; only production and live-backup-2026-10-02 remain).
